hooks.note: ME10, with HE11.3. VTuberEffect keeps the last rendered image for up to 25 ms (renderedImage), longer than the pipeline turn that leased the pool buffer; Swift's CVPixelBuffer stays alive through ARC.
ME10, with HE11.2. The lease follows VTuberEffect.renderedImage: renderModel's result always replaces it, so the previous buffer returns to the pool at the end of the turn.
